articles.title: The brand new 2027 Kia EV3 SUV debuts at New York International Auto Show
articles.mainIdea: The brand new 2027 Kia EV3 SUV debuts at New York International Auto Show
articles.summary: CNW Group: The brand new 2027 Kia EV3 SUV debuts at New York International Auto Show. The all-new 2027 Kia EV3 made its North American debut today at the New York International Auto Show as the latest dedicated EV from Kia, following EV4 and EV5. The EV3 offers the advanced amenities of the award-winning EV9 in a smart and approachable package. Ultimately, it is designed to deliver efficient, all-electric performance with a compact footprint.
